Contract AirportSystem::createDevice(id: Integer,name: String,location: String,contactsid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		devSet: Set(Device) = Device.allInstance()->select(d|d.Id = id),
		contactStaff: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(s|s.Id = contactsid)
	precondition:
		contactStaff.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		if devSet.isEmpty() and
		contactStaff.oclIsUndefined() = false 
		then let newDevice: Device in
		newDevice.oclIsNew() and
		Device.allInstance()->includes(newDevice) and
		newDevice.Id = id and
		newDevice.Name = name and
		newDevice.Location = location and
		newDevice.Contacts = contactStaff and
		result = true 
		else result = false 
		endif 
}
